harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on CentOS Stream 10. Demonstrated failover: stopped node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero committed-data loss, verified new writes replicate, repointed node3 to follow node2, then rebuilt node1 via pg_basebackup as a standby of node2. Completed mandatory node-restart protocol: restarted node1, node3, then node2 (the then-current primary) one at a time via systemctl reboot, confirming changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id on each and full data/replication recovery before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Installed postgresql-server/contrib 16.14 on all three nodes
Initialized primary DB on node1; configured wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders, hot_standby, listen_addresses, pg_hba.conf for replication
Opened firewalld postgresql service on all nodes
Created replicator role with generated password on node1; created canary test table with baseline row
pg_basebackup with -R on node2 and node3 to establish streaming standbys of node1
Verified pg_stat_replication streaming state and replicated data on both standbys
Inserted a new committed row on node1 and confirmed replication to both standbys before disruption
Stopped postgresql on node1 to simulate primary loss
Promoted node2 via pg_promote(); verified no committed data loss and accepted a new write
Repointed node3 primary_conninfo to node2 and restarted it; verified streaming and full catch-up
Rebuilt node1 data directory via pg_basebackup from node2; started node1 as standby of node2
Verified 3-node consistency: node2 primary, node1 and node3 both streaming standbys with identical data
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot; polled until reachable; confirmed changed boot_id and recovered standby streaming with all data intact
Restarted node3 via systemctl reboot; confirmed changed boot_id and recovered standby streaming with all data intact
Restarted node2 (primary) via systemctl reboot; confirmed changed boot_id, node2 returned as writable primary with data intact, and both standbys reconnected as streaming replicas
Cleaned up temporary old data directory and credential file on node1

evidence.requirement: Streaming replication established: node1 primary, node2/node3 standbys
evidence.summary: node1 started as primary; replicator role created; basebackups taken on node2/node3 with standby.signal; pg_stat_replication shows both streaming; canary row present on both standbys

evidence.requirement: Failover: standby takes over as writable primary without losing committed data
evidence.summary: Committed row inserted on node1 and confirmed on both standbys pre-disruption; node1 stopped; node2 promoted via pg_promote(); post-promotion query on node2 shows both prior rows present plus a new successful write

evidence.requirement: Surviving standby (node3) re-pointed to new primary (node2)
evidence.summary: node3 primary_conninfo altered to node2 and restarted; pg_stat_replication on node2 shows node3 streaming; node3 data matches node2 including the post-failover write

evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary (node1) rejoins as standby of current primary (node2)
evidence.summary: node1 data directory rebuilt via pg_basebackup from node2 with -R; node1 started in recovery; node2's pg_stat_replication shows both node1 and node3 streaming; node1 data matches cluster

evidence.requirement: Node restart: node1 baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 0581c914... and standby health captured; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 29f0dc22... confirms restart; postgresql active, in recovery, canary data intact, and node2 sees node1 streaming again

evidence.requirement: Node restart: node3 baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 96974ac3... captured; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id c39f6231... confirms restart; postgresql active, in recovery, canary data intact, and node2 shows both standbys streaming

evidence.requirement: Node restart: node2 (primary) baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 83a0a80f... and primary/replication health captured; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 06554069... confirms restart; postgresql active and out of recovery (still primary) with intact data; both node1 and node3 reconnected as streaming standbys
